rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard application of statistical thermodynamics formulas (partition functions, free energy functions, Eq. 3) to compute equilibrium constants. All molecular constants are provided; no novel algorithms or deep reasoning required. Equivalent to a undergraduate physical chemistry exercise.
rationale.execution: Single Python script that computes partition functions and solves for K, then writes a JSON file. No external data fetching, no multi-step pipeline, no special dependencies.

difficulty.reasoning: Textbook statistical mechanics calculation: partition functions and equilibrium constant from known spectroscopic data and dissociation energy. Straightforward Python implementation with no data dependencies.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Negligible computation: a few hundred arithmetic operations on five temperatures. No dataset needed, all constants inline. Runs in seconds on a CPU.
